moments.text: Wide black-and-white infrared view from the aircraft, flight data overlay dated 26AP2013: the sensor pans over coastal buildings to the airport runways and a parked aircraft.
The sensor zooms in. A small dark object moves across runways and taxiways near the crosshair as the camera follows it.
The dark object keeps pace near the crosshair over fields and trees, a long runway, then rows of houses and buildings.
The ground turns to tree cover, then a striped surface of waves; the small dark object is hard to pick out.
Black flash, then a closer zoom with a box: the dark blob crosses right to left past the crosshair, then drifts back to it.
On the crosshair the blob briefly swells, then slides right, shrinks to a dot and fades out in about a second.
A small dark dot reappears beside the crosshair for about 2 s, moves right and fades again.
Wider view of open sea; near 2:34 a small dark dot shows beside the crosshair for about a second.
Closer zoom after a white flash: two small dark blobs side by side drift toward the crosshair and separate, one passing above, one below.
Only the lower blob stays visible, moving down and right of the crosshair.
The view widens: open sea with the coastline along the bottom edge; the zoom flips in and out briefly near 3:06.
Widest view: coast, airport runway and town across the lower half, haze above; a white flash at 3:25 and a dark frame at 3:31.
